items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Warren Bell was playing alto, lead alto. And I was playing lead alto.

ctx.x: On the bandstand. Did he put you in the studio?

Yeah. He put me in the studio. Yeah. No, well, the way he would, he would switch it around. How would he work? If it was something that he could use me on, he would. But the first records he made, I believe, was, for Imperial, was The Fat Man with Fats Time. You were Fats. Yeah, I wasn't with Fats then. And later on, the guy got sick and the guy that took sick, I replaced him, so I replaced him in the studio. He used Joe Harris sometimes. Sometimes it would be three of us, three reeds. Sometimes. And then I got a…
Well, the problem was under Tommy Sidney.
